controles.affirmation: Reglement des demandes d'injonction signe le 10 novembre 2025, approuve a titre preliminaire le 9 juin 2026, motion d'approbation finale deposee le 15 juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On November 10, 2025, Visa and Mastercard entered into a superseding and amended settlement agreement to resolve the Injunctive Relief Class claims and the Injunctive Relief Class plaintiffs filed a motion for preliminary approval of the settlement, which was granted on June 9, 2026. On July 15, 2026, the Injunctive Relief Class plaintiffs filed a motion for final approval of the settlement.

controles.affirmation: Trois marchands ont depose une class action le 21 avril 2026 pour faire invalider la clause de renonciation future du reglement des dommages
controles.verbatim_source: On April 21, 2026, three merchants that are members of the Damages Class filed a MOTION FOR PARTIAL SUMMARY JUDGMENT in MDL 1720 seeking a declaration that the forward-looking release in the Amended Settlement Agreement resolving the Damages Class claims is invalid and unenforceable under federal law. ; On April 21, 2026, Potayto-Potahto, LLC and two other merchants filed a class action complaint ... asserting violations of federal antitrust laws consistent with allegations made in MDL 1720.
controles.correction_proposee: Deux actions distinctes du 21 avril 2026 sont fusionnees a tort. L'attaque contre la clause de renonciation future est une MOTION EN JUGEMENT SOMMAIRE PARTIEL, pas une class action ; la class action deposee le meme jour (Potayto-Potahto) allegue des violations du droit antitrust federal. Reformuler : 'trois marchands ont depose le 21 avril 2026 une motion en jugement sommaire partiel visant a faire declarer nulle la clause de renonciation future, et, le meme jour, une class action antitrust distincte'.

Plainte du DOJ deposee le 24 septembre 2024 pour monopolisation du marche des reseaux de debit, toujours pendante ; aucune evolution rapportee dans les trois 10-Q FY2026
controles.verbatim_source: On September 24, 2024, the U.S. Department of Justice filed a complaint in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York against Visa alleging violations of the Sherman Act. The complaint alleges Visa has monopolized and attempted to monopolize general purpose debit network services and card-not-present debit network services in the United States ... On June 23, 2025, the court denied a motion to dismiss filed by Visa. (10-K FY2025). Verification : 0 occurrence de 'Department of Justice' dans les 10-Q du 30/01/2026, 29/04/2026 et 29/07/2026.

controles.affirmation: Annulation du standard de la Regulation II par un tribunal federal en aout 2025, pouvant aboutir a un plafond d'interchange debit nettement plus bas
controles.verbatim_source: in August 2025, the District Court for the District of North Dakota ruled that the Federal Reserve exceeded its authority in implementing Regulation II ... the court vacated Regulation II's debit interchange fee standard ... If the District Court of North Dakota's decision is affirmed on appeal and ultimately prevails, it could potentially result in the Federal Reserve setting a significantly lower interchange cap for relevant debit transactions in the U.S.

controles.affirmation: Plainte de marchands europeens a la UK High Court le 20 avril 2026, autres en mai et juin 2026, Visa anticipe d'autres plaintes ; plus de 1 200 marchands depuis 2013, plus de 100 dossiers ouverts, plus de 950 regles
controles.verbatim_source: On April 20, 2026, a group of merchants from across Europe filed a claim in the UK High Court against several Visa entities ; In May and June 2026, additional merchants asserted claims in the UK High Court ; Since July 2013, proceedings have been commenced by more than 1,200 Merchants ... Visa has settled the claims asserted by over 950 Merchants, and there are over 100 Merchants with outstanding claims ... The Company anticipates additional claims in the future.

controles.affirmation: Le CAT a juge le 18 fevrier 2026 que l'interchange n'etait, sauf exceptions, pas repercute par les marchands ; appel autorise le 17 mars 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On February 18, 2026, the UK Competition Appeal Tribunal (CAT) issued a decision finding that, except in certain merchant categories, interchange was not passed on by merchants, and Visa has sought permission from the UK Court of Appeal to appeal that decision. On March 17, 2026, the UK Court of Appeal granted Visa permission to appeal the June 2025 decision by the CAT that certain interchange rates restrict competition under UK competition law.

controles.affirmation: La tresorerie a baisse de 4,8 Mds$ en 9 mois pendant que Visa rachetait 16,5 Mds$ d'actions, PAYAIT 3 MDS$ DE LITIGES et 1,5 Md$ pour Prisma
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan : ligne distincte 'Restricted cash equivalents-U.S. litigation escrow | 888 | 2,990', separee de 'Cash and cash equivalents | 12,359 | 17,164'. ; 'Deposits into the U.S. litigation escrow account | 875 | 375'
controles.correction_proposee: Les 3 007 M$ ont ete decaisses depuis le compte sous sequestre (restricted cash), pas depuis la ligne de tresorerie de 12 359 M$. Le seul flux de tresorerie disponible consacre aux litiges couverts sur 9 mois est le depot de 875 M$ dans l'escrow. Reformuler : '... pendant que Visa rachetait 16,5 Mds$ d'actions, deposait 875 M$ dans le compte sous sequestre des litiges et payait 1,5 Md$ pour Prisma ; le sequestre lui-meme est passe de 2 990 a 888 M$ apres 3 007 M$ de versements aux marchands.'

controles.affirmation: Dette totale 23,9 Mds$ apres emission de 3 Mds$ d'obligations en fevrier 2026 ; l'empilement rachats + litiges + acquisitions est finance en partie par de la dette nouvelle
controles.verbatim_source: Repayments of senior notes | (5,565) | — ; Proceeds from issuance of senior notes | 2,995 | 3,924 ; Bilan : Current maturities of debt 2,996 | 5,569 et Long-term debt 20,862 | 19,602 (total 23 858 M$ au 30/06/2026 contre 25 171 M$ au 30/09/2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Le montant de 23,9 Mds$ est exact mais la conclusion est inversee : sur 9 mois Visa a rembourse 5 565 M$ de senior notes pour 2 995 M$ emis, et la dette totale a RECULE de 25,2 a 23,9 Mds$. Reformuler : 'malgre l'emission de 3 Mds$ en fevrier 2026, la dette totale recule de 25,2 a 23,9 Mds$ grace a 5,6 Mds$ de remboursements ; l'empilement rachats + litiges + acquisitions est donc finance par la tresorerie et le cash-flow, pas par de la dette nouvelle.'
